## Install

1. Download `sherlockchiang-gcal-agenda-v*.zip` below and extract it into `%APPDATA%\com.seelen.seelen-ui\widgets\` (you should end up with a `sherlockchiang-gcal-agenda` folder there).
2. Restart Seelen UI.
3. Right-click an empty part of the top bar → **Modules**, tick **Date (Google Calendar)** and untick the built-in **Calendar**. Drag the new item to where you want it.
4. Click the date, then **Open Seelen settings** in the popup, and enter your own Google OAuth Desktop client. See the [README](https://github.com/SherlockChiang/seelen-calendar-agenda#readme) for the full sign-in steps.

## 安装

1. 下载下面的 `sherlockchiang-gcal-agenda-v*.zip`，解压到 `%APPDATA%\com.seelen.seelen-ui\widgets\`（解压后应有一个 `sherlockchiang-gcal-agenda` 文件夹）。
2. 重启 Seelen UI。
3. 在顶栏空白处右键 → **模块**，勾选 **日期（Google 日历）**，取消勾选自带的 **日历**，再把新模块拖到想要的位置。
4. 点击日期，在弹窗中点 **打开 Seelen 设置**，填入你自己的 Google OAuth 桌面客户端。完整登录步骤见 [README](https://github.com/SherlockChiang/seelen-calendar-agenda/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)。

Tested with Seelen UI 2.8.10. Built from this tag by GitHub Actions.
